headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Bectors Food Specialities Limited Q2FY27 Result Update 2 | P a g e ( 0 9 t h N o v 2 0 2 6 ) For any further query, please email us on research@venturasecurities.com Key consolidated financial data (INR Cr, unless specified) Net Revenue EBITDA Net Profit EBITDA (%) Net (%) Adj.
Bectors Food Specialities' Q2FY27 performance reflected strong execution across its core biscuit and bakery businesses, delivering record quarterly revenue despite elevated input cost inflation.
Revenue from operations grew 14.3% YoY to INR 630.5 cr, while EBITDA increased 19.1% YoY to INR 82.5 cr, with margins expanding 50 bps to 13.1%.
Segment-wise, biscuit revenue grew 9% YoY to INR 383 cr, while bakery revenue increased 22% YoY to INR 237 cr.
valuation: The company added approximately 30,000 outlets against its annual target of 40,000.
EBITDA margins are targeted at 13.5%-14% by Q4FY27, with a medium-term aspiration of 14%-15%, supported by operating efficiencies, distribution expansion and premiumization.

Valuation Call: We re-initiate coverage on the stock for a price target of INR 301 (32.8X FY29E EPS) over the next 24 months with a potential upside of 43.8% from the CMP of INR 239 over the next 24 months.
